summary: Replaced remaining `unity-agent` identifiers across the codebase: renamed localStorage keys (with legacy fallback reads), attachment manifest tags (with legacy tag parsing), Tauri crate name and binary, app identifier, and removed `UNITY_AGENT_HOST/PORT/ORIGINS` env fallbacks plus a stale README claim about `UNITY_AGENT_DATA_DIR`. Updated related test strings.
decisions: Renamed attachment manifest tags to `<gizmo-attachments>` but kept `<unity-agent-attachments>` parsable via a legacy span matcher so historical stored content still reads correctly.

Removed `UNITY_AGENT_HOST`, `UNITY_AGENT_PORT`, and `UNITY_AGENT_ORIGINS` env-var fallbacks rather than preserving them — these were half-dead (e.g. README claimed `UNITY_AGENT_DATA_DIR` support that didn't exist in code), so dropping them aligns documentation with behavior.
Removed the README sentence claiming `UNITY_AGENT_DATA_DIR` was still supported, since no such fallback existed in `defaultDataDir`.

For `apps/app/src-tauri`, renamed the Rust crate from `unity-agent` to `gizmo` and updated the Tauri identifier to `dev.genge.gizmo` (note: this changes the built binary name and app-data directory, so user data will not auto-migrate).
For localStorage keys (`app-settings`, drafts, pinned-directories), used a new `gizmo.*.v1` key with a one-time legacy `unity-agent.*.v1` read on load, rather than silent rename.
